schedule.description: Schedule to run this rule that will be passed to a corresponding {@link CronJob}.

enableUserNotifications.description:
Enables user notifications for this rule's runs.
When true, DataValidation notifications will be generated for run lifecycle events (for example, when a run fails or transitions from fail to pass)
and dispatched to the recipients specified by {@link #notifyUserIds} and {@link #notifyUserGroups}.
If both recipient lists are empty or the notification service is not configured, no notifications will be sent.

notifyUserIds.description: The desired list of user ids to send DataValidation notifications.

notifyUserGroups.description: The desired list of user groups to send DataValidation notifications.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

userUpdatedFields.description:
System managed field that keeps track of which fields in the seed data obj were updated by a user (as opposed to
the provisioner/authorizer).  Fields in seed data objs that are updated by users will not have those changes
overridden by provisioning.

hidden.description:
Field that marks a seed data obj as hidden.  When a seed data obj that was created via provisioning (e.g owned by
c3), user removals of that obj are handled by marking the obj as hidden to prevent future provisioning from causing
them to reappear.

userOwned.description:
A seed data entry is considered to be user owned if either this flag is true or the {@link Meta#created created}
field of {@link Persistable#meta} is not the authorizer or provisioner.  This field is completely managed by the
system.  It will be set while creating an entry if it is being created by the authorizer and the
{@link UpsertSpec#forceUserUpdate} is set to true.

disabled.description: If true, any {@link #cronJob} will be disabled.

disabledBy.description: User that disabled the rule. Automatically inferred when calling {@link #disable}

disabledAt.description: When rule was disabled. Automatically inferred when calling {@link #disable}

title:
Base type which has all traits of a non Draft rule.
Along with being {@link SeedData}, it also manages the creation / update / deletion of the associated cron job. It is assumed that it
therefore, leverage the afterCallback methods to manage the lifecycle of the associated cron job.

PLEASE NOTE that this should be mixed to the "leaf" entity type or if not, then all the **after** methods should be
overridden again to simply get the implementation from this method.
name: DataValidation.Rule.NonDraftBase
